# PlainLedger - AI-Powered Financial Reporting Platform

> Clear financial reports. Anomalies caught early. CPA support included. The financial reporting platform for CPAs and business owners who want actionable insights without the manual work.

## About PlainLedger

PlainLedger is an AI-powered financial reporting platform designed for CPAs, accountants, and business owners. We help you connect your accounting software (QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, FreshBooks, Wave) and automatically generate clear financial reports while our AI catches anomalies before they become problems.

- **Website:** https://plainledger.io
- **Free Trial:** 14 days, no credit card required
- **Languages:** English, French (Canadian)

## Key Features

### AI Anomaly Detection
- Automatically scans financial data for inconsistencies
- Flags duplicate transactions
- Identifies missing entries
- Detects unusual patterns
- Catches errors before audits

### Financial Reporting
- Balance sheets
- Income statements
- Cash flow statements
- Trial balance reports
- Custom dashboards
- Multi-entity consolidation

### Integrations
- QuickBooks (Online & Desktop)
- Xero
- Sage (Intacct, 50cloud)
- FreshBooks
- Wave
- More coming soon

### CPA Support
- Every plan includes access to experienced CPAs
- Help interpreting insights and anomalies
- Premium plan: dedicated CPA with same-day response
